requirement_text: Accounts are assigned to individuals and must not be shared unless an approved technical or business process explicitly permits it.
Users are responsible for activity performed with their credentials and must protect authentication information from unauthorized disclosure.
Users must not disable, alter, evade, or interfere with security, monitoring, logging, filtering, encryption, or configuration controls.
hint_control: CM-5 (Access Restrictions for Change) or AU-9 (Protection of Audit Information)

requirement_text: Users must secure unattended devices by locking the screen or signing out and must follow approved session-security settings.
Passwords, passphrases, tokens, biometric factors, and other authenticators must not be shared.
Users must comply with current organizational authentication requirements, including multifactor authentication where required.
hint_control: IA-2 (Identification and Authentication); see IA-2(1)/(2) for MFA

requirement_text: Suspected credential compromise must be reported immediately and the affected credential must be changed or revoked through an approved process.
Endpoints must use an approved operating system and a configuration managed by the organization.
Users must not remove, disable, or modify approved endpoint protection, logging, patching, update, device-control, sharing, authentication, or other security settings unless specifically authorized.
Security updates and configuration changes must be applied through approved management processes.
Do not bypass malware scanning, data-loss prevention, encryption, content filtering, or other protective controls.
hint_control: SI-3 (Malicious Code Protection); DLP ~ AC-4; encryption ~ SC-8

requirement_text: Sensitive or confidential information may be sent only to authorized recipients using approved protection methods.
Organizational data must be stored in approved locations that provide appropriate access control, resilience, backup, and recovery.
locator: Section 3.3 Data storage, transfer, and backup
hint_control: CP-9 (System Backup) or SC-28 (Protection of Information at Rest)

requirement_text: Lost or stolen devices and suspected data loss must be reported promptly through approved reporting channels.
locator: Section 3.6 Loss prevention and incident reporting

requirement_text: Removable media and external storage may be used only when authorized and protected according to organizational requirements.
